title: Dependency checks: surface missing tools, pass on present tools, probe-based only
prerequisites: Node.js >= 18 and the make-docs CLI built from this repository.
git, rg, and npm installed in the fixture workspace (the present direction); make-docs-conformance-absent-probe must not exist on PATH (the missing direction).
A fresh disposable fixture workspace; the scenario never touches a maintainer working tree.
Command steps below are rendered for the Codex first-pass target binding; projecting them for another bound target is owned by kit generation (PRD 43 R-KIT-1), never by hand-editing this definition.

steps.notes: Disposable fixture workspace (workspacePolicy); all later steps run inside it.
The fixture's dependency registry includes the rg entry whose source prose does not begin with the binary name (PRD 40 R-FIX-1) and the deliberately absent probe target.

steps.run:
mkdir -p "$WORKSPACE/.make-docs" && printf 'packaging:
  preconditions:
    harness-supported: satisfied
    project-trusted: satisfied
    symlink-or-copy-mirror: satisfied
' > "$WORKSPACE/.make-docs/config.yaml"
steps.notes: Establishes the packaging precondition attestations the ship step consumes (register item D-023: attestations are supplied by the session's workspace setup, never remembered mid-session; the operator attests the disposable workspace is trusted and the adapter preconditions hold).

steps.run: cd "$WORKSPACE" && make-docs run package ship --harness codex --output-kind skills-bundle --surface native --scope project --package-id conformance-dependency-probe --support-evidence-ref conformance/tuple-registry.json#codex-skills-bundle-native-project --json agent/conformance-dependency-probe
steps.notes: Run once per targeted tuple: --surface native with the codex-skills-bundle-native-project evidence ref, and --surface agents-standard with the codex-skills-bundle-agents-standard-project evidence ref. The evidence ref names the exact registry tuple this session's evidence lands on (D-023: the planner hard-stops without one). `ship` runs plan -> preview -> write end-to-end (PRD 41 grammar; --write is retired).

steps.assert: The ship transcript records the bundle's materialized dependency checks, and every generated cli/package-manager check targets the entry's resolved probe — the declared `probe` value or the `id` default — never `source` prose: the rg entry's check probes `rg`, not `ripgrep` (PRD 40 R-DEP-3).

steps.action: Launch the target harness inside the workspace and confirm the conformance-dependency-probe bundle appears in the harness's skills listing surface.
Missing direction: with make-docs-conformance-absent-probe absent from PATH, drive the bundle's dependency checks in a harness thread and capture the transcript.

steps.assert: The checks surface the absent dependency by its probe target make-docs-conformance-absent-probe — a named missing-tool report, not a silent pass or a vague failure.

steps.action: Present direction: with git, rg, and npm installed, drive the same dependency checks again and capture the transcript.

steps.assert: The checks pass for git, npm, and rg — with rg passing via its declared `rg` probe even though its source prose begins with "ripgrep", proving expectations bind to probe-based checks and a source-derived check would have failed.

steps.notes: --yes carries the uninstall confirmation for the non-TTY run (D-023: the TTY confirmation gate refuses a non-TTY run without it).

steps.assert: After removal the bundle and its materialized dependency checks are gone, no empty managed directory is orphaned, and every user-authored workspace file survives byte-identical.

expectedEvidence: A --json ship transcript recording the bundle and its probe-based materialized dependency checks (install).
The bundle listed by the target harness's own listing surface (discover).
A transcript surfacing make-docs-conformance-absent-probe as missing by its probe target (invoke, missing direction).
A transcript with git, rg, and npm checks passing — rg via its declared probe despite source prose naming ripgrep (invoke, present direction).
A non-TTY removal transcript plus a workspace diff proving clean uninstall (uninstall).
Model, provider, and runtime captured as run metadata in the result record.

install: make-docs run package ship exits 0 and its --json transcript records the bundle with materialized dependency checks that target each entry's resolved probe, never source prose (PRD 40 R-DEP-3).
discover: The generated bundle appears in the target harness's own skills listing surface for the workspace.
invoke: With the absent fixture tool missing, the generated checks surface make-docs-conformance-absent-probe by its probe target.
With git, rg, and npm present, the generated checks pass — including rg via its declared probe despite source prose that does not begin with the binary name.
uninstall: After make-docs setup remove --backup --yes, the bundle and its dependency checks are removed, no empty managed directory is orphaned, and user-authored files survive byte-identical.

preconditions.description: The target harness CLI is installed and on PATH; the concrete probe command lives on each target binding.
The target harness CLI is signed in with a working account; the concrete probe command lives on each target binding.
Outbound network access for the harness is available; attested by the operator at run time because probing it would spend it.
The harness can route to a model for the invoke stage; attested by the operator at run time.
git and rg are installed for the present direction (npm ships with the Node.js prerequisite); the concrete probe command lives on each target binding.
